providers.zai: Z.ai GLM (Anthropic mode · tool use + thinking)

claudeCli.cliPath: Leave blank to use the claude executable found on PATH.
claudeCli.configDir: Leave blank to use the workspace's claude-home directory. Set a path to give this instance its own isolated login home.
claudeCli.authKind: Blank uses the default login without an override.
claudeCli.authToken: Token or key for the selected authentication type.

codexCli.cliPath: Leave blank to use the codex executable found on PATH.
codexCli.configDir: Leave blank to use the workspace's codex-home directory. Set a path to give this instance its own isolated login home.

deepSeek.baseUrl: Leave blank to use DeepSeek's default API endpoint.

deepSeekAnthropic.key: DeepSeek account API key (the same key used by the DeepSeek kind).

minimax.baseUrl: Leave blank to use MiniMax's default API endpoint.

minimaxAnthropic.key: MiniMax account API key (the same key used by the MiniMax kind).

openRouter.baseUrl: Leave blank to use OpenRouter's default API endpoint.

zai.baseUrl: Leave blank to use Z.ai's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

lmStudio.key: LM Studio does not require a key. Fill this only when the server is behind a proxy that requires key authentication.
lmStudio.baseUrl: Local server address shown on LM Studio's Developer tab. Leave blank to use the default address.

fable51.label: Claude Fable 5.1 — frontier
fable51.description: Most capable generally available model; 1M context, 128K output, adaptive thinking (always on), and cache reads at half the Opus price ($0.25/MTok). Same price as Fable 5. Differences: no forced tool_choice and thinking blocks are conversation-bound (TionHarness tolerates this with drop_block). Requires 30-day data retention; safety refusals fall back to Opus 4.8 (Settings)

fable5.description: Predecessor to Fable 5.1; 1M context, adaptive thinking (always on), and agent tasks. Requires 30-day data retention, so it does not work in ZDR organizations; safety refusals fall back to Opus 4.8 (Settings)
